items.action: Refresh CLI design, docs, demos, tokens, semantics, lint output, Blog applicability, and every affected decision card before generation resumes.

items.trigger: docs/blog tree commit differs from the frozen commit
items.action: Create a new exact-commit snapshot, review new and changed articles, then rebuild all hashes.

items.trigger: a selected component changes semantic keys or adds CLI semantic support
items.action: Replace structural CSS with semantic classNames, styles, or component tokens and add a visual case.

items.trigger: React concurrency, App context, portal, Modal, Drawer, Message, or Notification lifecycle changes
items.action: Rerun overlay placement, hook lifecycle, focus, theme, locale, and static-API lint checks.

items.trigger: Table scroll, sticky, fixed, virtual, expand, or span behavior changes
items.action: Rerun scroll-edge and virtual-table cases at all required viewports and tested zoom levels.

items.trigger: a project contract declares AntD v4 or another unmaintained major
items.action: Block the library-native contract and require a migration plan or an explicitly isolated legacy foundation.

items.trigger: generation selects an AntD component without a frozen CLI reference or without reviewed Blog links
items.action: Freeze the current component reference, review matching Blog articles, and add a decision card when the component affects page-level judgment.
